messages:
Ivy: heads-up micro rehearsal tomorrow 9:30 PT. we need final run-of-show, who owns chat, and the demo switch commands.

Ivy: run-of-show (micro):
- 0:00 welcome + logistics (Ivy)
- 2:00 benchmark narrative: cost vs latency (Marco)
- 6:00 short demo: hosted -> dedicated fallback (Dee)
- 12:00 live Q&A + short form CTA (Priya)
- 18:00 close

Dee: demo notes will toggle routing; primary=demo-hosted (redwood/v1-small), fallback=demo-dedicated (redwood/v1-medium-q). keep prompts tiny to avoid quantization diffs.

Marco: will condense benchmark slide to one visual and a single caveat bullet about quantization variance.

Priya: CRM mapping: hs_webinar_source=quarterly_micro, hs_interest_bucket=hosting:dedi. add hidden field model_demo_variant and utm_campaign=mar_micro_2026. I'll wire HubSpot workflow to tag leads.

Ivy: chat coverage: Priya owns lead link drops, I will triage product/SLA Qs. Marco to handle any bench/data questions.

Dee: copyable switch commands for stage manager (DEMO_TOKEN env var):
```
# fallback to dedicated
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"micro-demo","target":"redwood/v1-medium-q","reason":"latency_demo"}'
```
```
# reset to hosted
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"micro-demo","target":"redwood/v1-small","reason":"post_demo_reset"}'
```

InfraBot: Prewarm scheduled for demo-dedicated at 2026-03-24T09:23:00Z (requested by Dee).

Ivy: rehearsal checklist: be in greenroom 9:10 PT, captions on, start recording 9:25. Priya drop one-pagers in rehearsal folder. See you. :rocket:
